512-1355-2872.easyPrerequisites: Sanctum Weaver and Clever Conjurer do not have summoning sickness.
512-1355-2872.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two enchantments.
512-1355-2872.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Clever Conjurer and Sanctum Weaver, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-1355-2872.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Sanctum Weaver's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

1453-8095--5.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat

4381-6797--5.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Grumgully
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2049-3259-4742.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2049-3259-4742.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ogre Chitterlord as attackers.
Ogre Chitterlord triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2829-3497-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 3 life this turn.
2829-3497-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

1379-3259-5953-7296.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
1379-3259-5953-7296.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1379-3259-5953-7296.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2511-4605-4681-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand by paying {5}{G}{G} or from your graveyard for its harmonize cost by paying at most {5}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Karmic Guide and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1651-3263-4702-4891.description:
Activate Atsushi by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Put the Atsushi token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Atsushi token dies, it triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures, untapping Atsushi.
Repeat

628-997-3108.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat.
628-997-3108.notes: You can remove the additional -1/-1 counters from Grim Poppet and put them on other creatures as desired.

413-643-4338.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Maskwood Nexus, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2146-3532-5078-6768.notablePrerequisites: Uthros Research Craft has at least 12 charge counters on it.
2146-3532-5078-6768.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a charge counter from Uthros Research Craft.
Uthros Research Craft triggers, putting a charge counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

730-880-6763.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
730-880-6763.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the land enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

488-2478-4708-4986-5754.notablePrerequisites: One of either Dark Sphere or Mishra's Bauble must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-2478-4708-4986-5754.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Phlage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phlage enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Phlage trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Phlage trigger, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to gain 3 life.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2292-4200-6132.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Icewind Stalwart.
2292-4200-6132.description:
Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying its mana cost.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Icewind Stalwart.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart ability, blinking Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Icewind Stalwart from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-2079-5686.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-2079-5686.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

3558-5147-5220-5683.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds.
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Crookshank Kobolds and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Repeat.

575-1207-4693.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken Forest.
575-1207-4693.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a nontoken Forest, which is a creature due to Ambush Commander.
When the Forest dies, Yedora triggers, returning the Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat.

2034-5003-5663.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cayth, adding {C}{C}.
When Cayth dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Cayth from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Cayth enters the battlefield, its fabricate ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

413-1445-1913-4871.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one artifact creature card in hand.
You have at least one artifact creature card in your graveyard.
413-1445-1913-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding an artifact creature card, returning another artifact creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Imotekh triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
When the Necron Warriors enter the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers twice, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a Necron Warrior.
When the Necron Warrior dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1069-1475-5147.notablePrerequisites:
One with the Kami attached to any creature you control.
You control at least one Equipment.
You control at least one additional creature.
1069-1475-5147.description:
Activate an Equipment's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to any creature you control except Puresteel Paladin or the creature that has One with the Kami attached.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with the Equipment attached.
When the creature dies, One with the Kami triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to that creature's power.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

3621-4659-5003.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it and Nim Deathmantle triggers.
Resolve the Su-Chi Cave Guard trigger, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

2506-3580.description:
Cast Lightning Crafter by paying its mana cost.
When Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability and Molten Echoes triggers.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Lightning Crafter with haste.
When the Lightning Crafter token enters the battlefiled, its champion ability triggers, exiling the nontoken Lightning Crafter until the token Lightning Crafter leaves the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate the Lightning Crafter token by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Resolve the champion ability from step 2, exiling the token Lightning Crafter.
The token Lightning Crafter leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Lightning Crafter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2050-2066-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Arbor Elf.
Fertile Ground attached to a Forest you control.
2050-2066-4222.description:
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping the enchanted forest.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Arbor Elf.
Repeat.

624-3518-4812-5131.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Phantasmal Image from your graveyard by paying {U}{U}.
Phantasmal Image enters the battlefield as a copy of Muldrotha, putting original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Animate Dead from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}, targeting Muldrotha.
Muldrotha enters the battlefield, putting Phantasmal Image into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.
